title: Levity bladders stored at Arneb carried to Crimson War Citadel (Krynn) and stored there, for the HEXC supply contract of 750
note: 2026-11-25 13:20 UTC (Mercury): orders ENT-093 P1, rule F39 channel 2 (partner Notice Board contracts, filled by title). Crimson War Citadel's board offers `HEXC supply contract: Levity Bladder`, 750 to deliver at that station for 55,125 cr (74 a unit; board read 13:18 UTC, data/missions); levity bladder bids 1 to 2 cr everywhere read (table books 13:19 UTC). A delivery objective counts the goods in the pilot's storage at the target (game/rules/07-economy.md, 0.727.1), so the load is stored at Krynn run by run and the contract is accepted and handed in once one pilot's storage there holds 750. A pilot whose own storage at Arneb holds 30 or more withdraws a hold and stores it at Krynn; nothing is bought or sold. Road 6 jumps, 3 lawless (arneb, kornephoros, albireo): one ship (rules F3, F37).
